verdict.rationale: The evidence points to enterprise and cloud-platform paths: the README lists "Enterprise features: Advanced security and compliance" and paid-tier access, and the official docs say the CLI runs without extra setup in Google Cloud Shell. None of it explicitly documents enterprise SSO/IdP or cloud-project authentication, and one user reports login failing for a Google Workspace account. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of enterprise identity or cloud-project auth flows, confirmation that Workspace/organizational accounts can sign in, independent corroboration of enterprise auth working.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can authenticate through an enterprise identity or cloud platform for compliance and scalability
